evidence.name: Screen field: Spacing between lines
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Spacing between lines" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Spacing between lines
sections.description: Controls the vertical gap between lines in a multi-line block. Roughly 1.3 to 1.5 times the font size reads comfortably for body copy, with tighter spacing for big headlines. Bump it up if a paragraph feels cramped, or down if a headline's lines drift apart. It only matters when text wraps to more than one line.
